name: User Integration
description: Connect users to the pool: onboarding hooks, Feed Delivery Agent (Concierge), feed generation

tasks.title: Create Feed Delivery Agent (Concierge)
tasks.description: Create v1/agents/feed_delivery.py with scoring system that pulls items from pool and ranks them for a specific user. Implements the Multi-Signal Scoring from AGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md.
acceptance_criteria: Reads user_profiles/{uid}, user_preferences/{uid}, user_patterns/{uid}
Queries retrieval_pool for items matching user's umbrellas
Implements 8-signal scoring: tag affinity, source type, query specificity, freshness, quality, trending, novelty, content depth
Applies diversity filter (max 3 per domain, max 8 per type)
Returns top 20 items sorted by score
Deduplicates against user_seen_urls (last 14 days)
Can be run: python v1/agents/feed_delivery.py --user_id abc123
tasks.verification_command: python v1/agents/feed_delivery.py --user_id test_user | python -c 'import sys, json; data=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(data)<=20; print("✓ Generated feed with", len(data), "items")'

tasks.title: Create feed generation script for one user
tasks.description: Create v1/generate_feed.py that runs Feed Delivery Agent for one user and saves result to user_feeds/{uid}/daily/{date}. Must match exact schema frontend expects.
acceptance_criteria: Takes --user_id as argument
Runs feed_delivery.py to get scored items
Formats items to match frontend schema: {id, type, title, description, url, tags, source, metadata: {why_relevant}}
Saves to: user_feeds/{uid}/daily/{date} with structure: {date, items, generated_at}
Updates user_seen_urls/{uid} with new URLs
Can be run: python v1/generate_feed.py --user_id abc123
Frontend can load this feed without errors
tasks.verification_command: python v1/generate_feed.py --user_id test_user && echo '✓ Feed saved to Firestore'

tasks.title: Create bulk feed generator
tasks.description: Create v1/run_user_feeds.py that generates feeds for ALL onboarded users. This runs after daily batch (5 AM).
acceptance_criteria: Queries user_profiles where onboarded=true
For each user, calls generate_feed.py
Handles errors gracefully (logs failure, continues to next user)
Logs progress: 'Generating feeds for 150 users... [50/150]'
Can be run: python v1/run_user_feeds.py
Outputs: 'Generated feeds for 150 users in 2m 34s'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/run_user_feeds.py && echo '✓ Bulk feeds generated'

tasks.title: Test feed display in frontend
tasks.description: Manual verification that frontend can display v1-generated feeds. This is NOT code - just a checklist to verify.
acceptance_criteria: Run: python v1/generate_feed.py --user_id {your_actual_uid}
Start frontend: cd frontend && npm run dev
Login and navigate to /feed
Feed displays items without errors
Items have correct icons (video/blog/paper)
Clicking items opens URLs
Can upvote/downvote items
No console errors related to feed data

tasks.title: Create onboarding hook
tasks.description: Create v1/hooks/on_user_onboard.py that runs when a new user completes onboarding. Creates umbrella if needed, maps user to queries.
acceptance_criteria: Takes --user_id as argument
Reads user_profiles/{uid} to get interests
For each interest: check if umbrella exists, create if not (run Trend Discovery)
Adds user to query_users for all sub_queries in their umbrellas
Generates first feed immediately (emergency search if pool empty)
Can be called from external script or API
Outputs: 'User onboarded: created 1 umbrella, mapped to 8 queries, generated initial feed'
tasks.verification_command: python v1/hooks/on_user_onboard.py --user_id test_user_new && echo '✓ User onboarded'

tasks.title: Update existing users to v1 schema
tasks.description: Create v1/scripts/migrate_existing_users.py that takes existing users and creates umbrella/query mappings for them.
acceptance_criteria: Runs init_umbrellas.py first
Runs map_users_to_queries.py to connect users
Generates initial feeds for all existing users
Idempotent: safe to run multiple times
Outputs: 'Migrated 100 existing users to v1 schema'

completion_criteria: run_user_feeds.py generates feeds for all users
Frontend displays v1 feeds correctly (manual test passes)
New users can onboard and get feeds immediately
